name: Dental tool set
description: A cloth roll of fine steel picks, a scaler and a small mirror.
notes: The picks double as crude lock picks and leather awls.

name: Bag of antiseptic cotton balls
description: A small zip bag of cotton balls kept damp with antiseptic.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (box/volume x4.7) is the air round the round balls in their bag; the reference volume is the cotton alone. Mass includes the bag.

name: Antiseptic rag
description: A folded cotton rag soaked in antiseptic. Fine for scrapes, poor for deep wounds.

name: Inhaler
description: A pocket inhaler that opens tight airways. A few puffs can leave the hands shaky.

name: Liquid bandage spray
description: A small pump bottle that sprays a thin film over cuts and scrapes.
notes: CHECK MASS (x6): the reference 5 g is the empty bottle; as a liquid the whole filled bottle is one item, so the mass includes about 25 ml of liquid.

name: Sachet of sterile gauze
description: A thick cotton gauze pad sealed in a sterile paper pouch.
notes: The film window is painted flush with the pad's white cloth.

name: Oxygen kit
description: A cylinder of medical oxygen with a regulator and face mask. Eases smoke and breathing trouble and gives a short burst of energy.
notes: Variants share this model, so they show the regulator and mask too; a bare cylinder model would suit them better once one exists.

name: Butane tank
description: A large steel cylinder of butane fuel.
notes: Variants share this model, so they show the regulator and mask too; a bare cylinder model would suit them better once one exists. The reference butane tank is far larger (24 l) than this model; a larger cylinder row needs its own model.

name: Hydrogen tank
description: A compressed hydrogen cylinder with a red shoulder.
notes: Variants share this model, so they show the regulator and mask too; a bare cylinder model would suit them better once one exists.

name: Pressure tank
description: An empty steel cylinder rated for compressed gas.
notes: Variants share this model, so they show the regulator and mask too; a bare cylinder model would suit them better once one exists.

name: Nitrogen tank
description: A compressed nitrogen cylinder with a black shoulder.
notes: Variants share this model, so they show the regulator and mask too; a bare cylinder model would suit them better once one exists.

name: Jet injector
description: A pistol-grip injector that drives a fast-healing dose through the skin without a needle. A label warns against more than two doses an hour.
notes: Brand name dropped; the amber vial on top shows the dose.

name: Scalpel
description: A steel surgical knife with a small curved blade, very sharp.
notes: Lies flat in the xz plane, as flat-bladed tools do.

name: Trauma shears
description: Angled shears with a blunt tip, made to cut through dressings and clothing.

name: Small oxygen kit
description: A small cylinder of medical oxygen with a folding regulator and mask.

name: Syringe
description: An empty plastic syringe with a capped needle.
notes: Drawn back and empty; the dose slot takes the barrel's clear finish.

name: Thermometer
description: A plastic card thermometer that reads the air temperature.
notes: Tool quality: temperature_measurement, for anything that reads air temperature.

name: Blood draw kit
description: A sealed kit with a winged needle, a holder and a sample tube for drawing blood.
notes: Laid out on its backing card; the clear lid is left off so the contents show.

name: Sealed dosimeter badge
description: A radiation badge still sealed in its shielding foil pouch. Open it to wear it.
notes: The opened badge is another item.
